reviews.title: Poor product and horrible company warrentee
reviews.comment:
I’ve got through 2 of these and the company doesn’t had no SLAs on warrantee. I’ve been waiting for months and they only respond that it’s been escalated and don’t compete the warrantee exchange.  

I recommend Samsung SSDs they have been bullet proof. These failed in same device and company lacks responsiveness.

I can’t recommend this product - stay away. They aren’t the same company from years ago….
